categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies `cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in` and `contrib/devtools/gen-manpages.py`, which is release and development documentation tooling.
categories.rationale: Prevents generating and accidentally committing incomplete manpages when building with features like wallet or ZMQ disabled. As noted in issue #17506, 'gen-manpages output depends on build options, so needs to check them' to avoid shipping incomplete documentation with releases.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: The tools category explicitly states that 'Build and release scripts are build', placing `gen-manpages.py` under the build domain.
categories.rationale: Excluded from tools because manpage generation is part of the build and release tooling pipeline covered under the build category.
